title: Equip your F****** TOTEM!
description: Reminds you to equip a totem every 2 minutes.
body:
A very simple clientn mod that reminds you every 2 minutes to equip a totem.
Designed for survival gameplay, this helps prevent accidental deaths and losing valuable items due to forgetting a totem in your offhand.
Especially useful on SMPs where one mistake can cost all your gear, especially a SMP that is based off of a donut where if you die you respawn 10 million blocks away from where you died. 
I may or may have not of made this mod because I died from pearling and suffocating and I was too slow to equip a totem in my offhand.
